changelog: Refreshed all base rates from 2024-11 baseline to 2026-02 current pricing.
Applied cumulative 6.5% to 8.5% materials escalation derived from CPWD Cost Index (CI Mumbai 2025-2026) and Maharashtra PWD SSR 2025-26 revision.
Escalated skilled & semi-skilled construction labour by ~8.8% following the Maharashtra Minimum Wages Revision (Basic + VDA) and Builders Association of India (BAI) Mumbai advisory.
Updated retail market cement prices from ₹415 to ₹440/bag (OPC 53) reflecting limestone mining royalties and diesel freight adjustments.
Updated primary TMT rebar (Fe500D) from ₹72 to ₹77/kg.
Added 'escalated_from' and 'escalation_pct' attributes to maintain provenance traceability.

gst_note: Material basic rates are exclusive of 18% GST for cement, steel, RMC, and MEP items, and 12% for bricks and stone. Works contract composite labour and material services attract 18% GST under SAC 9954.
notes: Rates vary across Greater Mumbai wards: Island City (South Mumbai) incurs 10-15% logistical premium due to daytime heavy vehicle entry restrictions (no-entry zone 8AM-8PM).

Suburban locations (Andheri, Borivali, Ghatkopar, Mulund) align with expected rates, while peripheral areas (Vasai-Virar, Thane, Navi Mumbai) benefit from 5-8% transport discounts near stone quarries.
Monsoon season (June to September) causes 15-25% price inflation in river/manufactured sand due to sand mining bans, and slows down concreting work.
Ready Reckoner Rate (RRR) does not govern material supply, but impacts municipal development charges and premium FSI scrutiny fees paid to MCGM.
